amendment_protocol: Any change requires a new Majles Al Ihsa convening with all 5 seats present (#19 Miriam, #20 Tariq, #10 Roshani, #11 Kwame, #22 Priya). No v0.3 on Path A under ANY outcome.

cardinality_precondition.binding_clause: INERT means 'test did not execute on its intended target'. Neither PASS nor FAIL.

secondary_diagnostic.description: Report A-D on full set alongside, but it is not the gate. Do not allow full-set value to substitute when stratum is INERT.

derivation_sources.statement: Bootstrap-CI on mean AUC is unreliable below ~30 independent units at AUC scales 0.50-0.55. Standard error of difference-of-means at n<30 swallows a 0.03 effect at alpha=0.05 / power=0.80.
Partial-pooling shrinkage at 10-12 L1 sectors x 2-3 cells/sector = 20-30 falls at the EB-literature small-sample threshold for hierarchical models.
Conventional minimum from peer-reviewable EB methodology; ratified by Miriam (#19) on 2026-05-12.

n_justification.binding_clause: N is the gate. The gamma-stage sensitivity sweep at {3,5,7,10,15} is a TRANSPARENCY artifact, not a decision artifact -- it documents stratum shape but does NOT shift the gate.

prior.hypothesis: cascade methodology carries real signal in the regime it was designed for
prior.rationale: Meaningful but not modal. Small downward update from 0.35 pre-v0.1a prior, reflecting v0.1a INERT verdict (not a falsification-level update).

consequences: proceed to Path B (hierarchical-Bayes redesign) OR ML pivot
no v0.3 on Path A frequentist track

bayesian_posterior_update_protocol.operational_requirement: v0.2 report executive summary MUST state: prior, posterior, magnitude of update, and whether the update is material (>=0.15) -- even if rule v2 returns a clean PASS or FALSIFY.

inert_canonicalization.auto_decision_rationale_clause: INERT is neither PASS nor FAIL; cascade does not re-deliberate methodology on an INERT result; cascade fixes the instrumentation and re-runs.
inert_canonicalization.semantics: test did not execute on its intended target

exit_criterion_table.single_seed_protection: Each tier requires 3 conditions to fire. A noisy random-baseline delta or a single category-mean shift will not, by itself, fire HARD-FALSIFY.
exit_criterion_table.no_v0.3_clause: No v0.3 on the Path A frequentist track under ANY outcome.

tiers.name: HARD-FALSIFY
tiers.consequence: Cascade methodology direction closes PERMANENTLY. No v0.3 path on Path A. ML track absorbs methodology load. Cascade keeps running only as sanity-check baseline for ML.

tiers.name: SOFT-FALSIFY
tiers.consequence: Halt; convene Majles. Default next phase: Path B (hierarchical-Bayes redesign). No v0.3 on Path A.

tiers.name: PARTIAL
tiers.consequence: Methodology has weaknesses worth documenting but is not dead. Path B (hierarchical-Bayes redesign) becomes next phase, not v0.3 of the same Path A design.

tiers.name: PASS
tiers.consequence: Methodology vindicated. Phase 6 begins on the now-validated EB framework.
